english.title: Solemnize a marriage in an unauthorised church / building
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly and wilfully solemnized a marriage between **(..SPECIFY PARTIES TO THE MARRIAGE..) not being a marriage by special licence, a marriage according to the usages of the Society of Friends or a marriage between two persons professing the Jewish religion according to the usages of the Jews, in a place, namely **(..SPECIFY PLACE..), other than a church or other building in which marriages may be solemnized according to the rites of the Church of England or the registered building office, approved premises or person's residence specified as the place where the marriage was to be solemnized in the notices of marriage and certificates required under Part III of the Marriage Act 1949
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(2)(a) of the Marriage Act 1949.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The term 'marriage schedule' replaced the term 'certificates' from the 4th May 2021 by the Marriage Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/411). For offences which occur after this date, please see H23039.
(ii) An offence under section 75(2)(a) of the Marriage Act 1949 is not committed where the marriage was a marriage by special licence, a marriage according to the usages of the Society of Friends or a marriage between two persons professing the Jewish religion according to the usages of the Jews.
